investigation_notes.Description: The alert was generated for unusually large, high-entropy DNS TXT traffic (2,420 bytes vs typical 12) to x1j2k3-v9.biz originating from a SQL server. The root domain was created 26 days ago and the subdomain labels decode to clear sensitive items including a SELECT query, an encrypted DB password token, an admin email, and an SSL key fragment. The combination of recent domain registration, high-volume TXT payloads, and decoded content that appears to contain confidential system and credential data indicates likely DNS-based data exfiltration and elevates this to High Priority.
